messages:
erin: Quick postmortem follow-up from the 02:20 UTC cross-region retry storm. Root cause short: aggressive probe timeout + instant SNI fallback routed traffic to a lower-capacity pool, causing retry amplification. I attached the postmortem link — please ack ownership of items.

pager-bot: Postmortem uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-04-14-retry-amplification-cascade (tags: lb, dns, tls, postmortem)

samir: reading now. data note: the probe was 120ms; transient load pushed probe latency beyond that and our routing engine switched to fallback on first failed probe. Combined with client-side exponential retry at short intervals -> saturation.

kay: i'll take the routing policy fix. plan: add probe hysteresis (3 failed probes over 8s) and a weighted-capacity check before hard failover. staging -> canary -> prod. ETA: 2026-04-22 EOD.

michael: i'll own the canary gating and smoke harness. i'll add a forced-region header test and a handshake/cipher check in the canary pipeline. sample smoke: 
```
# canary-smoke.sh
curl -s -H "X-Force-Region: eu-west" https://edge.redwood.ai/health | jq -r .pool; openssl s_client -connect edge.redwood.ai:443 -servername edge.redwood.ai < /dev/null | grep "Cipher is"
```
ETA for harness: 2026-04-19 noon.

samir: short-term mitigation idea: during cert rotations, delay cipher-suite fallback for 3m windows and temporarily raise probe timeout to 600ms. Ops risk: may mask unhealthy backends. Need signoff + auto-rollback guard.

erin: if we take mitigation, require these controls: (1) rollback flag, (2) alert: retry_rate_by_region > 2% sustained for 5m, (3) auto-rollback if 5xx increases by >0.7% within 5m.

sre-lead: i'll schedule a weekly regression triage for 6 weeks: Tuesdays 15:00 UTC starting 2026-04-20. Invite lb, tls, dns, oncall. We'll review fallback_count, retry_amplification_ratio, and handshake_fail_rate.

kay: i'll add a preflight validation step to the PR: a canary run that exercises rotations and ensures preferred-pool retention. will include the sample smoke.

michael: adding alert runbook entries: thresholds and who to page. will wire alert to oncall rotation with playbook link. ETA: 2026-04-20 COB.

samir: action items recap: 
- KAY: probe hysteresis + capacity-aware failover (owner) — ETA 2026-04-22 EOD
- MICHAEL: canary gating + smoke/openssl harness (owner) — ETA 2026-04-19 noon
- ERIN: coordinate mitigation approval + communicate to oncall (owner) — ETA 2026-04-17 COB
- SRE-LEAD: schedule regression triage + invite list (owner) — scheduled 2026-04-20 15:00 UTC recurring

erin: please update PR/issue with timestamps, smoke logs, and any blockers. i'll close this thread when the production patch has been live and stable for 24h. :white_check_mark:

samir: quick follow: add a metric to emit when fallback selects a pool with < capacity_threshold% available so we can alert before saturation.

kay: noted, adding metric fallback_capacity_ratio. will include dashboard panel.

michael: acked. linking PR when ready.

erin: thanks team. if anyone wants to pick up additional ownerships or tighten ETAs, update the issue. closing comments here shortly.
